Text: I told the group i had finished my part of the report when i had only done half. We submitted it at midnight and they trusted me. I kept looking at the bad paragraphs i had pasted in and hoping no one would read them. I feel like a fraud. The part i had pasted was from an old report and the numbers did not match the rest of the document. I changed two of the figures and left the rest. Then i saved the file and sent it to the group before i could change my mind.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: my cashback finally came through. 1200 rupees from the app that i had given up on. I did a little spin in the hallway. so happy, i immediately ordered a book i had wanted for months.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: Slept at 10 and woke up at 6 and went for a slow walk in the park with a flask of tea. The grass was wet and a couple of old men were doing laughing yoga. nothing felt rushed. i feel like my head has finally settled. I took a flask of tea, a book and an old shawl. I met a group of kids playing cricket near the gate and stopped to watch for a few minutes. When i reached home the kettle was still warm in my bag.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: the group trip planning has turned into a mess. Five people want five different dates and nobody is paying the advance. I am the one chasing everyone on the chat and keeping the spreadsheet. I did not sign up to be the manager of this. so stressed, i feel like cancelling the whole thing.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: opened the door to find a huge cardboard box on the doorstep. I had not ordered anything. Inside was a plant, a small note and no name. i still do not know who sent it. completely stunned, i have asked the whole floor. It was wrapped in brown paper and tied with a jute string. The plant had thick green leaves and a tiny tag that said keep near the window. I placed it on the sill and watered it with half a glass.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: It was my last day at the old flat. i walked through every room one more time and took a photo of the window where i used to sit. I left the keys on the table and closed the door softly. i keep feeling a lump in my throat, i did not think i would miss it this much.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: My internship offer from Flipkart came this morning and the stipend is more than i expected. i screamed into the pillow so the neighbours would not hear. so happy, i called Isha first.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: Veer posted my private photo on the class group without asking. Everyone reacted and it was so embarrassing. He removed it after ten minutes but the damage was done. I messaged him to say that was not okay and he replied with a laughing emoji. i am so angry i cannot even look at the group. I typed three versions of the message and finally sent the shortest one. He replied with a laughing emoji and a thumbs up. I turned off the notifications for the group and left my phone on the shelf.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: idk why but today feels grey. nothing bad happened. i just feel like talking to nobody. The fan was on the highest speed and the room was still stuffy. I put on a slow playlist and stared at the wall.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: restless since the morning, cant sit in one place. not sure why. i walked the corridor three times and came back. I tried to read a book but the lines kept moving. Then i tried drawing and gave that up too.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: something good is going to happen i can feel it. no logic, just a bright feeling since i woke up.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: so cranky since morning, snapped at the first person who spoke to me and felt silly after. dont know where this mood came from.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: just sitting in the room with the window open. i feel warm and quiet and i dont know why. I wiped the counter twice and rearranged the shoes near the door. It did not make any difference.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: feeling oddly guilty today, like i neglected something. not sure what. The walk to the mess felt long and the line looked longer. I just stood and stared at the menu board.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: I woke up grateful. Nothing happened, i was just thinking about all the small things that are okay right now. weird feeling but nice.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: my hands are cold and my heart is thudding for no reason. sitting in the corridor trying to breathe slow. anxious about nothing.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: so tired of everything today. not sleepy tired, just tired. dont have a reason to give.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: I cried a little in the shower and i dont even know what it was about. The ceiling had a small crack near the corner and i traced it with my eyes again and again.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: kinda proud of how the week went. nothing big, just feel i handled things well.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: kinda surprised at how calm i am today. i expected to be a mess and i am not. idk why.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: feeling a bit down after dinner and cant explain it. the food was fine, the people were fine.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: Walked around the lake twice. The mind was just blank and happy. I had nothing to think about and it felt nice. Everyone in the hostel was playing something loud in their rooms. I put my headphones on and took them off ten times.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: irritated all through the lecture and i could not tell why. even the fan noise felt personal.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: I felt a wave of pride seeing my reflection in the shop window, which is weird. nothing special about the day. The bag was lying near the door and my shoes were still on. I did not move for a long time.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: the night feels heavy. i keep checking my phone but there is nothing i am expecting. just waiting for something.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: so jumpy today, every notification makes me flinch. no clue why. I made a sandwich and ate half of it standing near the window. The sky had a few thin clouds.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: feeling guilty about nothing in particular, again. this keeps happening on weekends.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: lying on the floor with the fan on and i feel completely fine. no reason, just fine. The rooftop was empty and the lights from the next building were blinking. I leaned on the railing.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: heart feels full tonight. thinking of nobody in particular, just thankful.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: overwhelmed all week and it is only wednesday. i do not even know what exactly is piling up. I stuck the list on the wall, took it down, and stuck it back again. The pen had stopped working halfway.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: Our flight to Jaipur got upgraded to business class for no reason and I was so surprised I kept looking at the boarding pass. Then at the gate I realised my laptop charger was in the checked bag and the presentation was in two hours, and I got really stressed. The gate area was crowded and my seat was in the third row. A man next to me kept asking about the baggage rules. I opened the laptop bag and found only the cables and a notebook, and i went through every pocket twice.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: Aarti covered for me at the front desk when i was late and nobody noticed. I was so grateful i bought her coffee. But then i realised i had told her a lie about why i was late and i could not shake the guilty feeling for the rest of the day. I wrote down the real reason on a sticky note and then tore it into small pieces. The coffee she liked was from the machine near the stairs and i had to try twice for the right change. She said thanks and went back to her screen.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: I finished my first full month of budgeting and stayed under the limit by 400 rupees. I felt really proud, i even showed the sheet to Tanmay. But then the electricity bill landed on my phone and wiped out the saving, and i felt that familiar tightness again. I had set aside 1500 for food and 600 for travel and tracked every rupee in a small notebook. On the last evening i added up everything and checked the total two times. Then i closed the notebook and put it next to the keyboard.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: We had a lazy sunday brunch with the old group at the new place near FC Road and i felt so full and relaxed. On the way back someone mentioned that Pooja is moving to Berlin next month and the mood in the auto changed, i went quiet. The place had mismatched chairs and a menu written on a blackboard. We ordered too many things and shared everything, and extra toast came without being asked. After that we walked along the road for a bit before getting an auto.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: A stranger paid for my chai at a stall in Hampi and refused to take the money back. I was honestly stunned, nobody does that. In the evening my waitlisted train ticket got confirmed and i walked around the market so happy.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: I yelled at Kunal for using my charger without asking and he looked really hurt. i felt terrible the whole evening. Later he came with two cups of tea and we sat quietly on the stairs, and everything felt okay again.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: The clinic made me wait for three hours and then said the report is not ready. I was so angry i almost shouted at the reception. Then an old woman in the queue shared her biscuits with me and asked about my day, i felt very thankful for the small kindness.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: I was terrified before the viva because i had not slept the whole night. Once i started answering the first question, i noticed i actually knew this stuff. By the end i was explaining the circuit diagram with confidence and i felt really proud of myself.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: The family group chat was full of old photos of the village house today and i read every message twice. It is being sold next month and i felt a lump in my throat. Then Vikram sent me a voice note with the sound of the old temple bells he recorded last time, and i was so thankful he thought of me. Someone had posted the picture of the courtyard with the old well, and another of the mango tree with a swing. I scrolled up and down several times to find the first one again. The chat had more than a hundred new messages by evening.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: We went for our first trip together to Udaipur and i was so happy walking beside the lake with her. Midway i realised i had told my friends i was too busy to attend Sagar's engagement, and i felt bad for lying. The boat ride was short but the sky had turned pink and gold over the water. We walked past a small market selling mirror-work bags and she bought one as a gift. I took a photo of her laughing next to a lamp and set it as my wallpaper.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: I have been sleeping 4 hours a night because of the deadline and i feel so stressed all day. Yesterday i finally slept 9 hours at Chaitanya's place and woke up feeling sorted and calm.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: The bank deducted 590 as 'annual charges' without any message and i was fuming. I called the helpline and after ten minutes of music, the voice said they will reverse it today itself. I was very surprised, it actually came back in an hour. I read the message from the bank again and checked the account statement for any other deduction. The amount had been taken early in the month and the line just said charges. I wrote down the date and the reference number on a piece of paper before calling.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: I signed up for the 10 minute lightning talk at the club and rehearsed it in the bathroom four times. When my name was announced my knees got weak but once I started speaking it was alright and I got a loud round of applause at the end. I felt so proud walking back to my seat. I had practised in front of the mirror and in the bathroom and even on the terrace with the wind blowing. The slides were only five and each had a single picture. After the talk i kept my notes in my pocket and walked out of the hall without checking my phone.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: Mira wrote me a three page letter on my last day at the PG saying how my random cooking nights made her stay sane. I read it on the train and was so touched i could not stop smiling. Then the train crossed the city limits and i realised how far i had come from all of them, the sadness hit slowly. The letter was written in blue ink on ruled pages, with a small drawing of a pressure cooker at the end. The train was full and i held it in both hands so it would not crease.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: I snapped at a junior during the lab and i immediately regretted it, felt like the worst senior ever. Later i apologised in front of everyone and he smiled, and i felt proud that i could say sorry without making excuses. It was a small mistake with the connections and the readings were off by a bit. I fixed the circuit myself and then we did the experiment once again from the start.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: We got a call from the college that the farewell has been advanced to friday and nobody was ready. I was shocked, we still have the group photo to take. Also Shreya said she cannot attend because of her exam in Lucknow and i felt sad that the group will be incomplete. The coordinators sent a long list of tasks on the group and everyone picked one. I took the decorations and the banner, which meant buying chart paper and glue that evening.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: The bus was empty and i got the window seat with golden evening light and i felt so peaceful. Then two men got on and started playing loud videos without earphones and i was boiling with anger within a minute.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: Our team got the best project award in the final review and we all hugged in the lab, i have never been so happy in this department. After the ceremony Prof. Desai said the report must be submitted in two days with corrections and my brain just froze, so stressed. The trophy was heavier than i expected and there was a printed certificate with all four names. We took photos near the stage and then in the lab with the prototype in the middle.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: I have to get the dental surgery done on monday and i keep imagining the worst. My stomach clenches every time i look at the calendar. Ruchi booked me a cab and said she will wait outside the whole time, and i felt so lucky to have her in my life.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: We had the breakup talk in the park and it was calm, which made it somehow worse. I walked home with my headphones on and felt completely empty. By night i made khichdi, opened the window and felt oddly at peace for the first time in a month. The park had a few joggers and a couple of old men on a bench. We talked without raising our voices, and when it ended we both said take care and walked in opposite directions.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: Manav kept interrupting me in the meeting to correct small things and i was so annoyed. Afterwards i said something snarky about him in the group and then saw he was reading it. i felt like a coward. I had prepared the numbers for two days and he questioned every second slide. The meeting ran for an hour and a half and half of it was spent on formatting.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: Turns out my short story got shortlisted in the college magazine contest, i could not believe it. Out of 70 entries mine was one of five and i walked taller all evening, feeling quietly proud.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: Rent is due tomorrow and my freelance client has not paid yet, my stomach is in knots. Then at 9 pm the payment notification popped up and i actually laughed out loud, so relieved and happy. I read the agreement again and the sheet said ten percent was the maximum hike. I copied the clause into a message and kept it as a draft. The building has four flats and we are the only ones who got a message.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: The lift stopped between floors for ten minutes and i started panicking, i hate closed spaces. When it opened there was a person standing there with a cake box, apparently the building was celebrating something, and i was so surprised i forgot to be scared.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: I completed my 30 day workout streak without missing a day and felt so proud i posted it on my story. A week later my knee gave up and the scan said no running for a month. I just stared at my shoes and felt miserable.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: Pranav shared his entire notes folder with me and said use whatever you want. I was so grateful, it saved me hours. But i opened it and saw 600 pages for a paper in 2 days and the stress hit immediately.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: The neighbours were drilling at 7 am on a sunday and i could not sleep, so irritated. I went for a long slow walk and bought a hot jalebi on the way back, and sitting on the steps eating it i felt completely fine. The noise went on for almost two hours with small breaks. I put a pillow over my head and then went for a walk along the main road.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: Divya showed up at my door with a gift for my promotion and i did not even know she remembered. I was so surprised. Then i remembered i had skipped her housewarming last month and the guilt came rushing in.

Author: Claude (LLM)
Text: I booked a solo trip to Manali, my first ever, and i have been jumping around the room since. Reading the weather updates about landslides made my heart sink though and i keep refreshing them, really worried.

Author: Claude (LLM)
